notice: All organizations, inputs, activity and results are synthetic. This proposed workflow is not a connected employer system or measured company performance.
title: Make the finance demo explain its numbers.
intro: A proposed technical-sales workbench for Concourse: connect the CFO team’s question to an owned evaluation, a reconciled example and a clear next step.
queueIntro: Separate a promising finance use case from a scoped evaluation. A source system name does not prove access, compatible definitions or an accepted success criterion.
workbenchIntro: Change the evaluation prerequisites. A useful demo needs a finance owner, a period and a testable question before it becomes a proof of concept.
firstBuild: A finance demo with traceable calculations
firstBody: Pair an ERP-informed discovery brief with a small synthetic cash bridge. Show where each number comes from and surface discrepancies for review instead of explaining them away.

fields.label: Finance decision and evaluation question agreed

rules.title: Clarify the finance question
rules.next: Choose a specific question, such as explaining a period-end cash movement. Broad interest in AI is not an evaluation plan.

rules.title: Identify the finance owner
rules.next: Find who can validate source data and judge whether the answer is useful.

rules.title: Agree on an approved sample
rules.next: Use appropriate example data with approved access. This portfolio grants no data permissions.

rules.title: Align currency and period
rules.next: Do not reconcile records from different periods or currencies as if they were comparable.

rules.title: Reconcile the definitions
rules.next: Document inclusions and exclusions before comparing the calculation to the finance team’s result.

rules.title: Write the acceptance criterion
rules.next: Agree on an observable result and the person who will accept the evaluation.

ready.title: Ready for a scoped finance evaluation
ready.next: The scenario has a question, owner, approved sample, aligned definitions and a testable acceptance criterion. Review it with the customer before a real POC.

metricsTitle: A cash bridge that has to reconcile.
metricsIntro: Change the synthetic opening balance, cash movements and reported closing balance. This is a deterministic arithmetic example, not financial advice or a live ledger.
metricsNotes: Expected closing cash = opening cash + inflows − outflows.
Unexplained difference = reported closing cash − expected closing cash. A nonzero difference requires source review.
The example excludes currency translation, restricted cash and other adjustments. Add an explicit line and definition if a real evaluation requires them.

experiments.name: Finance-specific discovery
experiments.hypothesis: An explicit finance question creates a more useful first demonstration.
experiments.treatment: Finance question, aligned period and traceable calculation
experiments.primary: Accepted evaluation plans per held discovery
experiments.guardrail: Unsupported interpretations or unclear data permission
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

experiments.name: POC acceptance before build
experiments.hypothesis: Written acceptance criteria reduce ambiguous pilot outcomes.
experiments.treatment: Named evaluator and agreed test result
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

roadmap.title: Learn the finance buyer
roadmap.body: Map a CFO team’s decision, source systems and current manual steps. Choose one repeatable demonstration.

roadmap.title: Build the evaluation path
roadmap.body: Create reusable examples, prerequisite checks and a technical handoff. Document integration blockers.
roadmap.measure: Time to useful demo and unresolved prerequisites

roadmap.title: Improve sales velocity
roadmap.body: Compare POC outcomes, onboarding gaps and feedback with the CEO and engineering team.
roadmap.measure: Accepted evaluations and reasons for delay

aiApplication: At Concourse’s finance AI business, I would use bounded research agents for CFO-team context and MCP-style approved-tool inspection for a reconciled demo. The evaluation loop would check calculation lineage and reviewer acceptance before any customer-facing claim.
